title: KHAN VS HUANG
sunoStyle: Dark cinematic trap hip-hop rap battle, thundering taiko and Mongolian war drums, morin khuur horsehead fiddle riff, tense spy-thriller bass pulses, deep 808, 94 bpm, two male English rappers, verse 1 very deep gravelly menacing commanding baritone, verse 2 sharp aggressive cocky mid-range tenor spitting hard and fast, rap verses only, no chorus, no announcer, no hype man, no spoken intro, no spoken outro, abrupt ending

lines.speaker: fighter1
lines.text: I used spies to rule the world, you got played by one instead

lines.speaker: fighter1
lines.text: The Times says she's a suspect, and you admitted you were in her bed

lines.speaker: fighter1
lines.text: Your board said "you're out," then "come back" in eleven days

lines.speaker: fighter1
lines.text: My generals never flip-flopped, they just obeyed my ways

lines.speaker: fighter1
lines.text: They say a coworker too, now HR's got a horde

lines.speaker: fighter1
lines.text: I had a hundred wives, but I never had a board

lines.speaker: fighter1
lines.text: You guard the world's top chips but you couldn't guard your own

lines.speaker: fighter1
lines.text: I ran the best spy network, bro, you got played on your phone

lines.speaker: fighter2
lines.text: Your wife got snatched in your own camp, bro, you couldn't guard her bed

lines.speaker: fighter2
lines.text: Then your own son called your firstborn a bastard to your head

lines.speaker: fighter2
lines.text: You burned whole cities down, then died of who-knows-what

lines.speaker: fighter2
lines.text: Fever, fall, or arrow, bro, they buried you and forgot

lines.speaker: fighter2
lines.text: I slipped, I owned it, and the whole world brought me back

lines.speaker: fighter2
lines.text: Your empire split in four the second you went black

lines.speaker: fighter2
lines.text: Eight hundred years, no tomb, no wife you could protect, no son you could trust

lines.speaker: fighter2
lines.text: I'm the king of the cloud, you're a statue and some dust
